questions.question: Select the most appropriate option for blank No. 5.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **'begin to'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us refer to this line from the passage, "But the mere thought of _____(3)______ on occasions like these would throw her _____(4)______ such a nervous state that a tiny muscle in the corner of her left eye would _____(5)_____ twitch."
 
• The word before the blank No 5 is **'would'** which is a **modal**.
 
• Modals are followed by **V1.**
 
• Only option 3 has v1 i.e **begin.**
 
• So, **'begin to'** is the correct option for blank No 5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Characteristics of modals:**

 
 
• Modals are auxiliary verbs which are used to express **certainty, possibility, willingness, obligation, ability, etc.**
 
• Modals never change their form i.e. we can't use **'s/es/ing/ed'** with them.
 
• Modals are followed by **bare infinitive** i.e v1 without to.

• Let's refer to this line from the passage, "In other respects, she was not a _____(2)______ nervous woman."
 
• The word after the blank is **'nervous'** which is an **adjective.**
 
• Therefore, we need an **adverb** to qualify the adjective 'nervous'.
 
• Out of the given options, only **'particularly**' is an **adverb**.

__
 
• **'Particularly' **is an adverb which means **'very or very much'.**

 
 
• **​E.g. **I don't **particularly **care what happens to him.
 
 
 
• Let's refer to this line from the passage, "In other respects, she was not a _____(2)______ nervous woman."
 
• Form the above sentence, we get to know that Ms Foster is** not a very nervous woman** in general.
 
• So, **'particularly'** is the correct word for the blank No. 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
